{"subject":"Claim C019336 past payer filing limit - write-off decision needed","body":"Hi billing lead,

Claim C019336 (patient PT0252, service code T1019, 7 units, date of service 2026-10-27, billed $42.70) was submitted on 2027-02-12, which is 108 days after care. Northwind Health Plan's filing limit is 45 days, so the claim is predicted to be denied under D03.

Editing the claim cannot fix this. I need a write-off decision on this claim. The visit itself (V003771, 98 minutes, verified) is documented, so the decision is about whether to write off the $42.70 rather than resubmit.

Please let me know your decision as soon as possible so the claim can be closed out."}
